    When appropriate, elements and ephemerides for the provisionally-designated objects have been published on the referenced Minor Planet Electronic Circulars (MPECs) and are accessible via the Computer Service. Designated objects without references turned out to be less interesting than initially thought and will appear in the next batch of Minor Planet Circulars, although ephemerides will be available in the Minor Planet Ephemeris Service. Objects listed as 'not interesting' turned out to be routine objects. Note that elements for objects that do not warrant announcement on an MPEC become accessible in the various web services after the orbits appear on a Daily Orbit Update MPEC.

    Notes on how to begin your own astrometric program are available.
